# Widget catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs.js from each widget's schema.json. Edit the schema, then run `npm run docs`. -->

Pick widgets from this list only. Before using a widget, open its README for the exact fields and an example.

Grid sizes: S = 3, M = 6, L = 9, full = 12 columns. Each row of widgets should add up to 12.

| Widget | Use when | Don't use when | Sizes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`bar_chart`](bar_chart/README.md) | Comparing a measure across categories (revenue by rep, tickets by priority) or a short run of periods (revenue by quarter). Use horizontal bars for rankings and long names. | There is only one number (use kpi), the user needs exact values for many records (use table), or there are more than 30 categories (aggregate to top N first). | M, L, full |
| [`kpi`](kpi/README.md) | The user wants a single headline metric at a point in time: a total, count, average, or rate (open AR, tickets this week, win rate). | Several values need comparing across categories (use bar_chart) or the user needs individual records (use table). | S, M |
| [`table`](table/README.md) | The user needs to see individual records or exact values: open tickets, top deals, overdue invoices, a list of accounts. | The point is a comparison or trend (use bar_chart) or a single total (use kpi). Don't dump raw data: aggregate or pick the top N. | M, L, full |
